## Sprint 42 impact summary (from sprint KPIs)
- **6 stories**; **17 applications impacted**; **19 dependencies impacted**
- **3 conflicts** (all high-risk deployment collisions) and **3 compliance issues**
- Testing effort: **36.7 hours**; health score **49**; release confidence **58**
- High-risk story: **ST-107**

## Per story (directly changed components)
- **ST-101** (payment limits): `payment-service`, `account-service`; downstream `customer-db`, `fraud-engine`, `notification-service`, `transaction-db`; groups core-banking, core-payments, customer-platform
- **ST-104** (profile fields): `customer-service`, `customer-db`, `crm`, `notification-service`; downstream `account-service`, `audit-db`, `card-service`, `loan-service`, `payment-service`
- **ST-107** (card freeze/unfreeze): `mobile-banking`, `api-gateway`, `card-service`, `authentication-service`; 16 downstream services; 8 deployment groups
- **ST-110** (velocity rule): `fraud-engine`; downstream `risk-engine`, `transaction-db`
- **ST-112** (biometric login): `mobile-banking`, `authentication-service`; downstream `account-service`, `api-gateway`, `card-service`, `crm`, `customer-db`, `customer-service`, `document-service`, `loan-service`, `payment-service`
- **ST-115** (statement footer): `document-service`; downstream `reporting-service`

## Risk dimensions flagged as top factors
- **ST-107**: security **93 (high)** — *card data*, *auth flow change*, *external API contract*; delivery **87 (high)**; operational **71 (high)** — *service criticality* on `api-gateway`, `authentication-service`
- **ST-104**: compliance **61 (medium)** — *pii data*, *nearby card data* (`card-service`), *database schema change* (`audit-db`, `customer-db`)
- **ST-112**: security **73 (high)** — *auth flow change*, *customer data*; operational **69 (medium)**
- **ST-101**: operational **44 (medium)** — *service criticality* on `payment-service`

## Compliance frameworks impacted
- **ST-107**: GDPR (medium), PCI DSS (high), SOX (low), Internal Governance (high)
- **ST-104**: GDPR (high), PCI DSS (medium), SOX (medium), Internal Governance (low)
- **ST-101**, **ST-110**: GDPR/PCI/SOX/Governance (none high; minimum scores 80)
- **ST-112**: GDPR (medium), SOX (low), Internal Governance (medium); PCI DSS not applicable
- **ST-115**: no framework applies (overall **100/100**)

## Conflicts (shared components)
- **ST-101 ↔ ST-107** on `account-service` (deployment collision, risk score **100**)
- **ST-101 ↔ ST-110** on `payment-service` (**80**)
- **ST-107 ↔ ST-112** on `authentication-service` (**100**)
